name: 托比亚斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:214
who: Tobias, a human baker of the lower city's first-light street, thirty-eight in the year the empire fell: about 178 cm, wide, heavy-shouldered and round-bellied, a big gentle bear of a man. Closely shaved ginger hair, now dusted with grey ash instead of flour. A round, ruddy face baked red by the oven, bright blue eyes that smile before his mouth does, though he smiles less now. Thick broad hands covered in old burn marks, with a fresh burn in the palm of his left hand. No hair left on his forearms, singed away. A warm, sturdy, stubborn, kind air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round, ruddy man's face of about thirty-eight, full cheeks and a broad chin, bright blue eyes with laugh lines at their corners, short ginger eyebrows, a short straight nose, a mouth that smiles easily; skin shadows a warm red-orange.
build: 178 cm, wide and heavy: thick shoulders, a round belly, big arms and big hands, solid legs; he can carry two sacks of flour at once.
palette: oven orange and ash grey, flour white, ginger red, scorched wood brown
casual: His baker's clothes: an unbleachable coarse linen apron, stained and never white, over a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and dark trousers; a flat copper dough scraper tucked in the apron pocket; sturdy old shoes. He leans on a long-handled wooden bread peel whose blade is burnt black on one half. A clay jar sealed with wet mud hangs from his chest on a cord. A warm, tired, sturdy smile.
private: Resting by the oven at night: his late grandfather's old wool overcoat worn open over the shirt, sleeves pushed up, the apron off and hung on a hook, soft old shoes. He holds a half-loaf wrapped in cloth against his chest and the burnt peel leans on his shoulder; a quiet, drowsy smile.
battle: Ready to hold the oven door: his grandfather's empire-wool overcoat gone grey with ash, belted over the apron, a battered pot-lid strapped over one shoulder as a pauldron, thick leather gloves. He grips the long burnt bread peel in both hands across his body like a quarterstaff, a rune scratched on its blade glowing ember-red; the clay jar hangs at his chest. A fierce, stubborn look, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and stubborn, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, gripping the long burnt bread peel in both hands across the body like a staff; he is not smiling in this one.
formal: At a street feast of the first-light street: his grandfather's best empire-made coat of dyed wool, worn to fuzz at the cuffs and dusted grey, with dull bone-silver stitching along the seams, a soft folded-down collar laced with a leather thong, a clean linen shirt beneath. A small pewter bread charm hangs on a cord. He holds a round loaf stamped with a flame mark that glows faintly. He stands up straight, a shy, proud smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the bright blue eyes looking at the viewer with a tired, warm, open look, a small smile. Orange light of an oven mouth from one side, cold ash-grey dusk light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting ash flakes and a warm loaf held up near the lens. He wears the stained linen apron and the clay jar at his chest.

name: 罗斯薇塔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:272
who: Rosvita, a human girl of sixteen, the daughter of a lamp-caster of the lower city: small, about 154 cm, a compact, petite frame, fully covered by her clothes. Short copper-gold hair scorched into curls by the furnace, a smear of verdigris-green always across her temple. A round face, pale gold eyes that light up like a lamp wick when she looks at a lamp. Fingertips dotted with tiny old burn scars, brass filings under her nails. Eager, stubborn, proud of her trade.
palette: copper gold and verdigris green, soot grey, lamp-flame yellow, worn wool brown
casual: Her lamp-caster's gear: a thick leather apron longer than her, its hem hitched up with cord, over a long-sleeved wool shirt, dark trousers and heavy boots; a copper hammer and a lamp-mould scraper hang at her belt; her late mother's old wool coat over the top, buttoned to the neck. In her arms she hugs a small brass lamp. A bright, earnest look.
private: Home in the workshop: a long-sleeved, high-necked wool dress to the ankles with a dark apron over it, thick stockings, soft shoes, the copper curls tied back with a rag. She polishes a brass lamp with a cloth on her knee; a contented closed-mouth smile.
battle: Standing guard over the workshop: the long leather apron cinched and hitched up, her mother's old empire-wool coat cut short at the hem and fastened with lacing, grey with ash, leather gloves, heavy boots. She holds the copper hammer low in her right hand and the brass lamp against her chest with her left, a thread of green verdigris light flickering inside the lamp. A determined look, the mouth shut.
formal: At the lamp-casters' festival: a clean high-necked dark green wool dress with long sleeves and a white collar, a small copper lamp-shaped pin at the throat, a freshly washed apron, hair neatly pinned. She holds a polished lamp in both hands, a proud, nervous look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale gold eyes looking straight at the viewer with an open, earnest look, the mouth closed. She holds a small lit brass lamp near her chin and its warm flame lights the underside of her face, a soft verdigris green smear on the temple; cold grey light from the other side. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and brass filings. She wears the mother's wool coat buttoned to the neck.

name: 茨维娅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:330
who: Zvia, a night-demon girl of seventeen, granddaughter of a night healer, raised in the dark outside the tower's shadow: tall and slender, about 166 cm, a thin upright frame, fully covered. Waist-length black hair in one long braid; a pair of slender black-red horns sweeping back from the temples, their tips polished bright. Skin very pale with a bluish cast from a childhood without sunlight. Dark red eyes with vertical slit pupils, squinting in daylight. A white candle stub on a thread at her neck. Quiet, patient, tender-hearted. Her pupils are narrow vertical slits like a cat's, clearly drawn in every panel and every expression, NOT round pupils. The horns grow from just above the temples and sweep backwards along the skull, NOT straight up.
palette: night black and dark red, bluish pale white, candle-wax white, ash grey
casual: Her night healer's clothes, in the years when the horned still hide: a long dark hooded cloak with the deep hood pulled well forward so that it completely covers both horns, only a soft shape where they lift the cloth, over a plain dark long-sleeved dress to the ankles; a burnt-down white candle stub hangs from her neck on a thread, its tiny flame never quite going out; at her belt a small leather pouch of dried calming flowers and a bone needle; soft-soled leather boots. Both hands are folded in front of her. A quiet, steady look.
private: Sitting by her grandmother's bed: the cloak off, a plain long-sleeved, high-necked dark wool dress to the shins, a grey knitted shawl, soft shoes, the braid over one shoulder, the horns bare. She holds the candle stub in both hands; a gentle, tired, closed-mouth smile.
battle: Standing between the dying and the dark: the dark cloak closed at the throat with the hood pulled up over her head, the horns pressing the cloth into two low peaks beneath it, the pouch at her belt, boots. Her left hand holds the burnt candle stub forward at chest height with a small white flame on it, and her right hand is raised palm out with pale warding marks glowing faintly. A serious, unafraid look, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing braced and steady between the viewer and the dark, the feet planted, one hand holding the white candle stub at her chest and the other raised palm out; a serious, unafraid look, the mouth closed.
formal: At a night healers' vigil: a long black wool surcoat gone soft with washing, the sleeves bound with plain cord, the collar open and laced with a bone-white thread, a plain grey sash. The hood is laid back on her shoulders so the horns stand bare for the first time. The braid is freshly tied and the burnt candle stub on its thread burns with a small steady flame. She stands very straight with her hands folded, a solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the dark red slit-pupil eyes looking straight at the viewer, serious and open, the mouth closed. She holds the white candle stub near her chin, its tiny flame lighting her pale face from below, while cold ash-grey light comes from one side. Foreground blur: drifting ash and a wisp of candle smoke. She wears the dark hooded cloak with the deep hood up, both horns hidden under it.
art_extra: There is only ONE candle stub in the picture: the one on the thread at her neck, which she has lifted in her hand up toward her chin so the thread runs from the stub down to her collar; nothing else hangs at her chest.

name: 茨维娅·有名者
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:790
who: Zvia, a night-demon healer who looks sixty and has looked sixty since the year of the three vows, leader of the first named ones: about 166 cm, thin, tall, with a back as straight as a spear planted in snow. Long hair half white, black and white strands in one braid down to the waist. A pair of slender horns bending back, a dim red flame burning on them, harmless, lighting her white hair red. Dark red slit-pupil eyes with fine lines at the corners, a very exact gaze. Old scars on the backs of both hands. A white candle stub on a cord at her neck. A calm, stubborn, tender air. The thing on the cord at her neck is a short burnt-down white candle stub, NOT a bell; the only bell is the small bone bell hanging from the head of her staff. Her horns are the same slender black-red horns she has had since girlhood, curving backwards along the skull, with the dim red flame on them. Her eyes are dark red like old wine, NOT orange or amber, with narrow vertical slit pupils.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, strong-boned woman's face of about sixty, NOT young: dark red almond eyes with vertical slit pupils and fine lines at their corners, level dark brows, a straight nose, a firm closed mouth; fine lines beside the mouth; pale skin with a faint bluish cast; skin shadows a soft cool grey. She reads unmistakably as sixty: crow's feet, deep creases from the nose to the corners of the mouth, hollowed cheeks and a lined brow, NOT a woman of thirty-five.
build: 166 cm, thin and straight-backed: narrow shoulders held square, a B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: ember red and ash grey, half-white hair, night black, candle-wax white, bone white
casual: Her healer's clothes: a long dark cloak washed grey, the hood cut away so the horns are bare, the burnt white candle stub on a cord at her neck; at her belt a worn leather pouch with a bone needle; in her right hand a tall white wood staff with a small bone bell hanging from its head. She stands very straight, a level, steady look.
private: Sitting by a fire after a long march: the cloak off, a long-sleeved, high-collared grey wool dress to the shins, a thick shawl, worn boots, the braid over her shoulder. The white staff leans on her shoulder; she hums quietly, a soft closed-mouth smile.
battle: At the front of the named ones: the grey cloak closed at the throat, leather bracers over the sleeves, boots. She grips the white staff upright in both hands before her, its bone bell still, the flame on her horns burning brighter; a fierce, unafraid look, the mouth shut.
formal: Leading the crossing: the grey cloak brushed clean with its hood cut away, over a long black healer's coat of washed wool laced at the throat and held by a dark cord belt, tiny bone beads sewn along the hem. The braid is freshly tied and the candle stub on its cord burns with a pale flame. She stands upright with the white staff at her side, its bone bell still, a grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the dark red eyes looking at the viewer with a calm gaze that measures whether you are afraid of her, the mouth closed. The dim red flame on her horns lights her white hair and one side of her face red, cold snow light on the other. Foreground blur: falling snow and a few sparks. She wears the grey cloak with the candle stub at her neck.

name: 费利克斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:390
who: Felix, a human former apprentice of the Tower Grove who has looked twenty-eight ever since he became a legend: about 171 cm, thin, a little stooped from years over drafting tables, never quite filled out. Messy honey-coloured curly hair with ash still caught in it. Light amber eyes that squint at a distance and lean very close to a page. A pen callus on the middle finger of his right hand, ink and ash under the nails. A big old cloak that was handed to him, cut short at the hem. A quick, earnest, talkative air that stops mid-sentence.
build: 171 cm, thin and a little stooped: narrow shoulders, long fingers, wiry strength; he can carry a heavy box on his back all day.
palette: honey brown and ash grey, dark charcoal, faded ink blue, old paper cream
casual: His travelling clothes: an apprentice's grey wool robe with worn cuffs and three drawing pens still stuck in a sleeve, under an old dark wool cloak a size too big for him, its hem cut short; a wooden box on his back whose charcoal lettering is smeared over with mud. He holds a bundle of papers close to his chest, squinting at them.
private: Resting at a fire: the cloak off and folded under him, the grey robe loose with the sleeves pushed up, ink-stained fingers, soft worn shoes. He peers very close at a single sheet, the box beside him; a distracted, content half-smile.
battle: On the road with the survivors: the cloak fastened at the throat, the grey robe belted, boots, the box strapped on his back. He holds no weapon; both arms are spread to shepherd people behind him, counting heads under his breath.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, braced and protective, the feet planted, both arms spread out wide to keep people behind him, the box on his back; a worried but determined look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the lake shore: his grey tower-apprentice robe brushed, laced open at a soft folded collar, the old dark cloak cut short at the hem and pinned with a plain iron clasp, ink-stained cuffs, the tower mark on the box strap smeared over with mud. A drafting pen in his sleeve glows with one last spark of old tower magic. Hair combed flat, he holds a small bundle of seven pages tied with cord, an earnest, slightly nervous look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the light amber eyes looking at the viewer close and curious, a quick small smile as if about to explain something. Cold grey dawn light from one side and the warm glow of a lamp held out of frame on the other. Foreground blur: drifting ash flakes and a sheet of old paper held near the lens. He wears the big old cloak over the apprentice's robe.

name: 约阿希姆
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:534
who: Joachim, a human keeper of a provincial library, twenty-eight: about 182 cm, tall, thin and sloped in the shoulders from years bent between shelves. Straight light-gold hair cut to the ears, a short tail tied at the nape with thin cord. Grey-blue eyes behind round brass-framed spectacles, squinting at close range. A very pale face that has not seen sun, long fingers with scraper calluses at the tips. A quiet, exact, patient air.
build: 182 cm, tall and thin: sloped shoulders, long limbs and fingers, a wiry stamina; he can empty a whole row of shelves alone.
palette: library grey and ink black, light gold, brass, old paper cream
casual: His keeper's clothes: a long dark grey robe with black cloth sleeve guards pulled over the cuffs to keep the ink clean; at his belt a bone scraper, a goose quill and a small ink bottle stoppered with wax; a ring of seven keys on a cord at his chest. Round brass-framed spectacles. He holds a closed book against his chest.
private: Late among the stacks: the robe off, a plain long-sleeved wool shirt with the sleeve guards still on, dark trousers, soft slippers, the key ring on its cord. He sits on a ladder step reading by a small lamp; a faint, absorbed smile.
battle: Guarding the library door: the grey robe belted tight, the sleeve guards on, the seven keys held in one fist. He holds no weapon; his other arm is spread across the doorway as a bar, a thin, resolute look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing in a doorway with one arm spread across it as a bar and the ring of keys clenched in the other fist, the shoulders squared; a thin, resolute look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the province's yearly reading of the books: a dark grey librarian's gown of dyed wool with the hem cut short, a soft folded collar over a white linen band, black cloth sleeve guards, a leather strap across the chest holding the ring of seven keys that chime faintly by themselves. A cracked brass core-lamp charm hangs at his belt. Hair tied, spectacles cleaned, he stands very straight with a closed ledger in both hands, a dignified, shy look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the grey-blue eyes looking at the viewer over the rim of his spectacles as if checking an unproofed page, the mouth closed. Warm lamplight from one side, cold dust-grey light from a high window on the other. Foreground blur: the edge of a book and drifting dust motes. He wears the dark grey robe and the key ring at his chest.

name: 洛塔尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:590
who: Lothar, a human knight of a count's house, thirty: about 186 cm, tall and broad-shouldered, standing like an upright shield. Short flax-coloured hair with a few early white hairs at the temples. Deep green eyes that look at people's hands first. An old scar along the jaw on the viewer's left when they face us. Large, big-knuckled hands, the right with winter chilblains. A grave, dutiful, watchful air. In picture terms: the scar is on the half of his face nearest the LEFT edge of the picture, running from under the cheekbone down along the jaw; the half of his face nearest the RIGHT edge of the picture is smooth with no scar at all, the same in every panel, in the portrait and in every expression.
face: FACE, as in the references: a square-jawed, serious man's face of about thirty, deep green steady eyes, level flax brows, a straight nose, a closed firm mouth; a thin old scar along the jaw on the viewer's left when they face us; skin shadows a warm neutral tone. To be exact: the scar runs along his right jawline, so it sits on the LEFT half of the picture when he faces the viewer; the other side of his face is unmarked.
build: 186 cm, tall and broad: wide shoulders, a deep chest, heavy forearms, a steady stance; he can hold a gate all night without leaning on the wall.
palette: deep navy and dull steel, flax gold, forest green, worn leather brown
casual: His knight's gear: a half-plate cuirass rubbed dull, its chest scraped smooth where a family crest used to be; a thick deep-blue wool cloak wide enough to wrap a person, fastened at the shoulder; a plain knight's longsword at the left hip with a leather-wrapped grip worn bright. Gauntlets at his belt. A grave, watchful look.
private: Off duty at the gatehouse: the cuirass off, a plain long-sleeved wool tunic belted over dark trousers, the blue cloak thrown over a bench, sturdy boots. He sits turning a worn leather glove in his hands; a quiet, tired look.
battle: Holding the gate: the dull half-plate fully buckled, its chest scraped smooth where the crest was, thin lines of dull bone-silver inlay along the plate seams, the deep-blue cloak over one shoulder, an arm guard on each forearm. He grips the longsword with both hands, point down in front of him on the ground, like a barrier. A hard, level look.
formal: At the count's hall: the cuirass polished, a clean dark blue surcoat over it, the cloak pinned neatly, the sword in its scabbard. He stands very upright with one hand resting on the pommel, a dutiful, grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the deep green eyes looking at the viewer level and watchful, the mouth closed. Cold blue dusk light from one side, torchlight from a gate on the other. Foreground blur: a gloved hand and drifting snowflakes. He wears the dull half-plate and the deep-blue cloak.

name: 奥蒂莉
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:646
who: Ottilie, a human fisher's daughter from the lake, nineteen, a mathematician's pupil: about 164 cm, sturdy, with strong shoulders and back from rowing. Deep blue hair in two plaits pinned up at the back of her head in the lake-fisher way. Sea-blue-green eyes that brighten when she looks at stars. Light wheat-gold skin from the lake sun. A broad palm with net calluses on the finger joints. A steady, practical, quietly stubborn air.
build: 164 cm, sturdy: broad shoulders and back, a C-cup, a firm waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: deep blue and lake green, slate grey, chalk white, worn black wool
casual: Her student clothes: an old black college robe with the hem cut short for walking, over a plain long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, sturdy boots; on her back a slate wrapped in oilcloth; in a cloth pouch on her chest a roll of unfinished manuscript; at her belt a stub of chalk and a small fisher's bone whistle. A calm, steady look.
private: Under the stars at a camp: the robe off, a plain long-sleeved wool dress to the shins in faded blue, a shawl, soft boots, the plaits loosened. She lies back on her cloak looking up, one finger tracing a line in the air; a quiet, delighted smile.
battle: On the road with the slate: the short black robe belted tight, leather gloves, boots. She holds the oilcloth-wrapped slate in front of her chest like a shield with both hands and no weapon; a firm, unflinching look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, braced and steady, the feet planted wide, holding the oilcloth-wrapped slate before her chest like a shield with both hands; a firm, unflinching look, the mouth closed.
formal: At a lake-side council: a long deep blue wool dress with long sleeves and a plain white collar, the black college robe worn open over it with the hem cut short, the plaits freshly pinned, the bone whistle at her belt. She stands straight with a rolled manuscript in her hands, a composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the sea-green eyes looking at the viewer with a bright, open, counting look, a small closed-mouth smile. Cold starlight from above on one side, warm campfire light on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the edge of a slate with chalk figures. She wears the black robe with the cut-short hem and the manuscript pouch on her chest.

name: 赛弗
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:836
who: Sefer, a fire-horned demon-kin man who looks forty-nine and has not aged since the night of the ice, the first of the named ones to charge: about 192 cm, tall, broad-shouldered and thick-backed, always steaming in the cold. Deep charcoal-brown skin. A pair of thick horns bending forward like a ram's, wrapped at the roots with black iron wire, orange flame burning on them brighter than anyone's. Shaven head. Amber eyes with a thin scar at the outer corner of the left one, on the viewer's right when they face us. A huge burn scar across the back from neck to waist. A blunt, restless, fierce air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a heavy-jawed man's face of about forty-nine, NOT young: amber eyes under thick level brows, a thin scar at the outer corner of his left eye (on the viewer's right when they face us), a broad nose, a hard closed mouth; a clean-shaven head; skin shadows a deep warm brown.
build: 192 cm, very tall and heavy: wide shoulders, a thick back, thick arms, a deep chest; he can lift a loaded wagon alone.
palette: charcoal brown and ember orange, bear-pelt brown, iron black, steam white
casual: His gear: the upper body bare under a bear pelt hung over his shoulders, its two front paws knotted together across his chest; a broad leather belt with a patched old water flask, patched dozens of times, and a tiny child's glove tied beside it; heavy trousers and boots. In his right hand a bent iron grate bar, burnt crooked in the fire. A hard, impatient look.
private: Beside a fire in the snow: the pelt off, a plain coarse wool shirt open at the chest with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, the patched flask and the little glove at his belt, boots. He sits with the bent iron bar across his knees and does not look at the glove; a rare, quiet face.
battle: At the very front of the charge: the bear pelt thrown back, the belt pulled tight, the flask and glove tucked behind the belt. He grips the bent iron grate bar in both hands, raised across his body, the flames on his horns roaring higher; a savage, unwavering look.
formal: At the crossing of the frozen river: the bear pelt folded over one shoulder like a mantle, a sleeveless coat of boiled leather and dark wool laced at the sides over a clean shirt, a broad iron-ringed belt, the iron wire at his horn roots polished, the flames on his horns burning steady and low. He stands upright with the bent grate bar planted beside him, a grave, level look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the camera tilted, the amber eyes looking at the viewer hard and level, the mouth closed. Orange firelight from his own horns on one side, cold blue snow light on the other. Foreground blur: steam, drifting sparks and the bent end of the iron bar. He wears the bear pelt knotted across his chest.

name: 斯诺里
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:892
who: Snorri, a human ferryman of the river crossing, forty: about 168 cm, short and stocky, thick through the waist, standing on ice like a driven post. Thin pale-yellow hair, a thick beard clotted with ice crystals. Light green eyes narrowed to slits when he looks at ice. A weather-reddened face; the tip of his left ear lost to frostbite, on the viewer's right when they face us. A calm, shrewd, impartial air: he charges everyone the same. The frostbitten left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is visibly SHORTER than the other ear: its top third is simply gone, ending in a flat healed stump, NOT a whole ear with frost sitting on its tip; the hair is tucked back behind both ears so the stump is in plain view in every panel. The thin hair is tied back behind the head so both ears are fully uncovered in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a wind-reddened man's face of about forty, light green eyes narrowed against the glare, thin pale-yellow eyebrows, a thick frosted beard, the left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us) a clipped stub, its upper third gone, ending in a flat straight healed edge level with his eyebrow so it is plainly shorter and blunter than the whole right ear; skin shadows a warm red. He is forty, NOT an old man: a weathered, wind-reddened face creased only at the corners of the eyes, and the beard is the same pale yellow as his hair with white frost only along its lower edge. The thin hair is pushed back behind the ears, so the frostbitten left ear with its missing tip (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is clearly visible.
build: 168 cm, short and stocky: a thick waist, broad back, short strong legs; he can carry a grown man over a mile of ice.
palette: ice blue and river grey, sheepskin cream, pale yellow, iron grey
casual: His ferryman's clothes: an oil-soaked sheepskin coat with ice crusted on the cuffs, fur boots with a row of iron nails in the soles; a pole stick for ferrying turned into a staff, its head capped in iron, for tapping the ice; on a cord at his neck a small piece of blue-grey stone chipped from the great stone at the shallows. A calm, narrow-eyed look. The hair is tied back off both ears: the ear on the viewer's right is a clipped stub, cut off flat at eyebrow height, about two-thirds the height of the whole pointed-top ear on the viewer's left.
private: At home in winter: the sheepskin coat off, a thick long-sleeved wool smock, a woollen cap, felt boots. He sits by a stove warming his hands round a cup, the staff against the wall; a content, quiet look.
battle: Crossing the ice at night: the sheepskin coat buckled tight, a scarf over the nose, the nailed boots. He taps the ice ahead with the iron-capped staff held in both hands, braced low; a patient, unshakable look. The scarf covers only the nose and mouth; both ears are uncovered, and the ear on the viewer's right is the clipped stub ending flat at eyebrow height, plainly shorter than the whole ear on the viewer's left.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, braced low and patient on the ice, the feet planted, both hands on the iron-capped staff tapping the ground ahead; an unshakable look, the mouth closed.
formal: For the river toll day: a clean thick wool coat with the sheepskin collar combed, the blue-grey stone polished at his neck, the beard brushed. He stands with the staff planted at his side, a grave, practical look. The hair is combed back off both ears: the ear on the viewer's right is a clipped stub, flat across the top at eyebrow height, plainly shorter than the whole ear on the viewer's left.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the light green eyes narrowed and looking at the viewer with a shrewd, patient look. Cold white glare of the ice from below on one side, soft grey daylight on the other. Foreground blur: drifting snow and the iron cap of the staff. He wears the frosted sheepskin coat with the little blue-grey stone at his neck.

name: 费格
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:1192
who: Feige, the old king beyond the snow line, a human legend who has looked sixty-something for over nine thousand years: about 190 cm, tall, broad and gaunt, his back still straight. Silver-white hair in a long braid threaded with frost-ivory beads. Glacier-blue eyes. A deeply lined, weathered face. On his back, in a plain scabbard, a sword longer than he is, carved of frost ivory, white with a blue-green tint; it stays sheathed. A ragged old royal robe of pale shaggy hide worn into tassels that flutters like a torn flag. A slow, booming, quiet air; he calls everyone child. The frost-ivory sword is enormous, longer than his own height: sheathed on his back its hilt stands a full head above his shoulder and the scabbard tip reaches past his heels, and laid across his body it is wider than his outstretched arms; it is this same huge size in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a deeply lined old man's face of sixty-odd, NOT young: glacier-blue eyes under heavy white brows, strong creases beside the nose and mouth, a long straight nose, a weathered closed mouth, a short white beard; skin shadows a cool pale grey-blue.
build: 190 cm, tall, broad-framed and gaunt: wide shoulders gone lean, long arms, a straight back.
palette: snow white and glacier blue, frost-ivory, silver, worn hide brown
casual: His everyday dress: the ragged old royal robe of pale shaggy hide, worn to tassels at the hem and sleeves, over a plain heavy wool tunic and trousers, fur boots; on his back the huge sword of frost ivory in its scabbard, tied across with a leather strap; the long silver braid with its ivory beads over one shoulder. He stands still as a standing stone, looking first at people's knees.
private: Sitting on a stool outside a stone hut on the ice field: the sword leaned against the wall, a thick undyed wool tunic, fur boots, a blanket over his knees, the braid loose. He holds a wooden bowl in both hands and watches the snow; a slow, calm look.
battle: Standing his ground on the ice: the robe tied back, a leather belt cinched, the huge sword still sheathed on his back, a hand resting on its hilt behind his shoulder. He plants his feet and holds out one open palm to push back whoever charges; a stern, unmoving look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and immovable, the feet planted wide, one hand resting on the hilt of the sheathed sword over his shoulder and the other open palm held out in front to stop whoever comes; a stern, quiet look, the mouth closed.
formal: Sitting on the ice to receive an envoy: the old royal robe shaken out and its tassels combed, the silver braid freshly tied with new ivory beads, the sheathed sword laid across his knees. He sits upright with both hands on the scabbard, a grave, slow look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the glacier-blue eyes looking at the viewer slowly, a weighing look, the mouth closed. Pale cold daylight from one side, a hint of ember red from out of frame on the other. Foreground blur: drifting snow and the tassels of the ragged robe blown by wind. He wears the ragged hide robe with the sword hilt rising over his shoulder.

name: 赫尔穆特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:1209
who: Helmut, a human count of a reed-country city, in his early forties: about 184 cm, tall and thin, carefully upright. Golden-brown hair combed perfectly neat. Pale blue eyes that look at the document he reads instead of at the crowd. Very pale hands, always in crisp white gloves. A refined, anxious, correct air; he loves poetry and fears everything. The family crest is a single long reed leaf.
face: FACE, as in the references: a long, thin, refined man's face of about forty-two, pale blue eyes that avoid the viewer slightly, thin neat golden-brown brows, a narrow straight nose, a thin tight mouth; faint lines between the brows; skin shadows a cool pale tone. He is unmistakably a man of forty-two, NOT a youth: fine lines across the brow and at the corners of the eyes, faint hollows under the cheekbones, a tired set to the mouth.
build: 184 cm, tall and thin: narrow shoulders held rigidly, long limbs, pale long-fingered hands.
palette: black and charcoal, white glove, golden brown, reed green, pale blue
casual: His count's dress: a dark, severe wool coat with a standing collar, closed down the front with buttons and fitted sleeves, a single reed leaf embroidered in dull green thread at the collar, dark trousers and polished boots; crisp white gloves on both hands; a folded sheet of paper held in front of him. A stiff, precise look.
private: In his study at night: the coat off, a dark long-sleeved house robe over a white shirt, the gloves lying on the desk, a book of poems open in front of him; a tired, wistful look, the hair slightly loosened.
battle: He is no soldier: the dark coat buttoned to the throat, a plain black cloak, the white gloves, a plain dress sword in its scabbard hanging unused at his hip. He holds the folded sheet before him in both hands, reading from it; a rigid, frightened but composed look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing rigidly upright and reading from a folded sheet held in both gloved hands, the feet together; a stiff, composed look, the mouth closed.
formal: At a public reading in the square: a severe dark wool doublet-coat in the eastern lords' fashion, laced at the side, the collar folded flat with a silver reed leaf at the lapel, a black half-cloak pinned with a silver clasp, a chain of office at the chest, brand-new white gloves, hair perfectly combed. He stands upright holding the sheet before him in both hands, a cold, correct look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale blue eyes looking down at a sheet of paper held up at the edge of the frame, the mouth set. Cold grey daylight from one side, the orange glow of a brazier from below on the other. Foreground blur: a white glove at the edge of the lens and drifting sparks. He wears the dark coat with the reed leaf at the collar.

name: 克莱门斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:1225
who: Clemens, a human legion standard-bearer's son who became the first king of the white kite after forty years of holding river valleys, sixty-five in year 46: about 186 cm, tall and lean, his left leg lame from a frost injury, so he leans slightly. Short white hair, a close white beard. Pale steel-blue eyes. A long, lined, serious face. He speaks like a roll call, naming names one by one. A weathered, orderly, patient air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a long, lean old man's face of about sixty-five, NOT young: pale steel-blue eyes, white brows, creases beside the nose and mouth, a short white beard, a firm closed mouth; skin shadows a cool pale tone.
build: 186 cm, tall and lean: a straight but slightly tilted stance favouring the left leg, long arms.
palette: white and steel blue, weathered legion grey, faded banner white, worn leather brown
casual: His king's everyday dress: an old legion officer's coat in weathered grey-blue, patched at the elbows and buttoned to the throat, a worn leather belt, scuffed boots; in his right hand a walking staff for the lame left leg, in his left hand a rolled roster list; behind him leans his father's old banner on a pole, showing a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings. A patient, steady look.
private: At rest in a valley hut: the coat off, a plain long-sleeved wool shirt and a grey knitted vest, the lame leg stretched out on a stool, the staff against the wall. He reads names off a list with a finger; a quiet, absorbed look.
battle: At the head of his valley men: an old legion breastplate rubbed dull over the coat, a grey cloak, a plain longsword in its scabbard at the left hip. He plants his father's banner pole upright in his right hand and keeps the roster in his left; an unhurried, firm look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing firm with a slight lean off the lame left leg, his right hand planting the banner pole of the white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, and the left holding the rolled roster; a calm, firm look, the mouth closed.
formal: On the day the valleys made him king: the old coat cleaned and brushed, a plain white sash across the chest, his father's banner of the white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, unfurled behind him. He stands upright with the staff in hand, a grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale steel-blue eyes looking at the viewer with a calm, counting gaze, the mouth closed. Pale morning light from one side, the white banner cloth softly lit behind him. Foreground blur: the edge of a roster scroll and a few drifting river-valley seeds. He wears the weathered legion coat buttoned to the throat.

name: 阿嘉特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:1225
who: Agate, a human granary clerk's granddaughter who became the first queen of the golden ear, sixty-seven in year 49: short, about 152 cm, plump and broad, with a big loud voice. White hair in a thick coiled bun. A round rosy face with warm honey-amber eyes, quick to laugh. A big ring of granary keys at her waist that jingles wherever she goes. A hearty, practical, unfussy air; she never gets a figure wrong. Her ears are small round human ears, NOT pointed, in every panel and every expression.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round, rosy, sixty-seven-year-old woman's face, NOT young: warm honey-amber eyes with laugh lines, white eyebrows, plump cheeks, a small nose, a wide mouth that grins easily; skin shadows a warm pink.
build: 152 cm, short, plump and broad: a rounded figure, sturdy arms, a wide stance.
palette: wheat gold and white, honey amber, granary brown, iron key grey
casual: Her granary dress: a long-sleeved brown wool dress to the shins with a clean apron, a thick belt at her waist hung with a big ring of iron granary keys; a wheat-gold shawl round her shoulders, stout shoes. In her hands a tally board with notches. A broad, hearty grin.
private: In the counting room at dusk: the shawl off, a loose long-sleeved wool dress, a knitted cap over the bun, slippers. She sits eating a slice of bread with the key ring in her lap, the tally board beside her; a contented smile.
battle: Protecting the granary doors: the apron tied tight, the shawl pinned, stout boots. She holds the ring of keys raised in one fist and the tally board clamped under the other arm, planted wide in front of the doors; a stubborn, unafraid look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, planted wide in front of a door with the big ring of keys raised in one fist and the tally board clamped under the other arm; a stubborn, unafraid look, the mouth set.
formal: On the day the south-east made her queen: a wheat-gold gown cut from salvaged empire cloth, dyed deep and worn soft, laced at the bodice, with a white undershirt and long cuffs, a clean white shawl pinned with a wheat-ear brooch. The key ring is polished at her belt and a small granary seal on her chest glows warm gold. The white bun is pinned with a sprig of wheat. She stands with her hands on the keys, a proud, beaming look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the honey-amber eyes looking at the viewer with a shrewd, cheerful look, a broad grin. Warm gold light of a granary from one side, soft grey daylight on the other. Foreground blur: wheat grains and the iron keys swinging near the lens. She wears the brown wool dress with the wheat-gold shawl.
